established: `{"kind": "subject_changed", "baseline": hex64}` — the baseline blob is a manifest `{"selector": [path…], "entries": {path: {"mode", "sha256"}}}` of explicit, sorted, repository-relative file paths (no globs, directories, symlinks or submodules).
residual: this record cites its witness cases and mutants and does not run them; CI runs the suites and tests/mutants.py before tools/claims.py check

"repository-relative": a path out of the repository is refused by the selector check and, without it, by git, which finds no such path in the tree, so the selector check has no mutant of its own; "no globs": a glob is not refused by name, it is looked up literally (git ls-tree) and finds no file, so it is UNEVALUABLE as a missing path, with no mutant of its own; a submodule is refused by the mode check and again when its blob cannot be read
